prompts.title: Wide cinematic key art, {style}, rich colour, a deep black starry space scene. Composition: everything sits in the left half and along the bottom; the top right quarter is completely empty plain black starry sky. Left edge: a tall white Saturn-type moon rocket climbing straight up on a long orange flame and billowing white smoke. Top left of centre: a small grey Moon. Lower left of centre: a large astronaut in a white 1960s spacesuit floating towards the viewer, gold visor reflecting orange flame. Bottom half: the huge curved limb of the Earth, blue oceans and white cloud bands, a bright orange and gold sunrise glow along its edge. Lower right: a cone-shaped space capsule with a service module tumbling slowly above the Earth. No text, no letters, no logos
